purpose: let the developer find and fix defects early by testing their own change before it is handed on
procedure: Re-read the acceptance criteria and list the behaviors to check, including error cases.
Run the unit tests and add tests for new behavior and for edge cases found.
Run the application locally and exercise each criterion by hand, including one unhappy path.
Check logs for new warnings or errors and verify data created by the change.
Run the project's checks (format, lint, type check) and fix problems.
Note what was and was not tested in the pull request.
acceptance_criteria: At least one error path was tried
validation_method: Reviewer reads the testing note and reruns key tests.

validation.command: pytest -q && ruff check . && mypy .   # example toolchain

validation.check: exercise each acceptance criterion locally and note the result
validation.expect: each criterion verified or gap noted

failure_modes.detection: Reviewer cannot tell what was verified

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A developer adds an export limit. They test 9,999, 10,000 and 10,001 orders locally, see the expected error at 10,001, add a unit test for the boundary and note that large exports were not load tested.
